eligibility: Low impact; reversible; non-sensitive; bounded authority; deterministic verification
minimum_automated_evidence: Schema validation; scope allowlist; sensitive-data scan; smoke test; effect receipt
human_gate: None inside approved policy; random audit sample
release_controls: Idempotency and automatic rollback for mutations
escalate_when: Novel tool or data class; test uncertainty; repeated failure; any external consequential effect

eligibility: Contained impact; reversible production or public work; moderate sensitivity; reviewer can evaluate
minimum_automated_evidence: Acceptance tests; relevant unit/integration tests; static checks; diff summary; preview
release_controls: Protected merge or send gate; staged rollout; rollback; monitoring
escalate_when: Privilege change; irreversible effect; high-sensitivity data; weak evaluator; domain specialist required

eligibility: Any high-risk dimension: financial safety legal security privacy production-wide or irreversible
minimum_automated_evidence: All standard evidence plus threat/hazard analysis; exact artifact hash; representative staging; rollback drill or impossibility record
human_gate: Accountable human and independent specialist when required
release_controls: Action-specific approval; canary; rate limit; kill switch; monitored window; execution attestation
escalate_when: No safe rollback; evidence conflict; policy ambiguity; approval mismatch; unexpected effect

eligibility: Private draft; reversible; no sensitive source; deterministic format requirements
minimum_automated_evidence: Template validation; citation placeholders; plagiarism/originality check; link syntax
escalate_when: Any public claim or sensitive source

eligibility: Public technical content with factual and reputational impact
minimum_automated_evidence: Source coverage; unsupported-claim audit; live-link check; metadata/schema validation; visual inspection
escalate_when: Legal medical financial claim; confidential evidence; real-person allegation

eligibility: Reversible service change behind normal deployment controls
minimum_automated_evidence: Changed-behavior tests; static analysis; dependency/security scan; performance budget
human_gate: Code owner or protected merge gate
release_controls: Staging; feature flag or canary; rollback; observability
escalate_when: Authentication authorization payment deletion or production-wide change

eligibility: Privileged security destructive financial or availability-critical change
minimum_automated_evidence: Full relevant suite; threat model; failure injection; exact plan; restore evidence
human_gate: Accountable owner plus security/SRE/domain review as applicable
release_controls: Canary; blast-radius limit; action-bound approval; rollback drill; incident owner
escalate_when: Unresolved test gap; rollback fails; environment drift; approval differs from plan

eligibility: Reversible transformation of internal non-regulated data
minimum_automated_evidence: Schema; reconciliation totals; lineage; completeness; freshness; data-quality tests
release_controls: Versioned output; quarantine; rollback to prior dataset
escalate_when: New sensitive category; irreversible deletion; downstream financial or legal use

eligibility: Email post payment contract or other action affecting an external party
minimum_automated_evidence: Verified identity; policy check; exact payload preview; effect idempotency; receipt reconciliation
human_gate: Authorized human sender or decision owner
release_controls: Action-specific approval; rate limit; audit log; stop control
escalate_when: Recipient ambiguity; policy conflict; sensitive data; no effect receipt
